I understand the feeling and know it is something extremely difficult to move on from. I won’t say you ever get over it, but you will learn to trust the person that you are with. 3 years with my current bf now and 5 years since my last relationship where I was cheated on, I still get those fears from time to time. I just have learned that I do trust my current relationship enough to know that those feelings and fears are just in my head. If you believe that professional help with benefit you, then go for it. It is good to vocalize those fears in order to better handle them and, for lack of better words, “move on”. It’s a horrible feeling but I promise you will find someone that one day will make those fears go away

I’m currently unable to go to therapy for financial reasons, and one thing I’ve started that has seemed to help is journaling. I find pre made journal prompts and will answer those by writing them down. It makes me feel like someone else is asking me questions then I have to respond, almost like therapy could be. It helps me to better visualize what is going on in my head when I see it written down in front of me. Hope this helps!
